label: Goofish (闲鱼)
reason: Invitation-only and hosting-restricted (re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium): https://open.goofish.com/ still redirects to the 闲鱼 login page (登录_闲鱼). The public 闲鱼小程序 docs now render - https://open.goofish.com/doc/quick-start.html says '闲鱼小程序目前不对外公开开放申请，只面向闲鱼运营小二定向邀请的服务商，未经邀请的注册将不予通过', and https://open.goofish.com/doc/development/dev/server.html requires every service to be deployed inside 聚石塔 ('用户id、订单信息等必须存储在聚石塔内的数据库中') and to call Taobao TOP APIs (alibaba.idle.isv.order.* / refund.query / goosefish.user.info.query) with per-API permissions granted by 闲鱼. No listing/product API is documented, and neither the invitation nor the in-聚石塔 hosting can be met by a self-hosted MCP server.
